npcs.name: Chief Odo
npcs.line: The street needs clearing. You up for it?

requires.hint: The Smog Warden guards the way. Defeat it to pass.
The Sludge Foreman holds the canal. Defeat him to pass.
Bottle throwers hold the corner. Knock down 6 to pass.
Pipe Brutes guard the car park ramps. Knock down 5 to pass.
Dock thugs hold the crossing. Knock down 8 to pass.
Punks block the Refinery road. Knock down 10 to pass.
The Pit Champion bars the back door to the Refinery. Beat him.
The Baron's enforcers hold the smelter. Knock down 5 to follow him.
Tar Rats swarm the tunnels. Knock down 12 to reach the Baron's door.
The Baron's men still hold the road to the port. Defeat the Baron first.
Stevedores block the road to the market. Knock down 6 to pass.

npcs.name: Uncle Chai
npcs.line: Forty years I've fed the dock crews. Never seen them this scared.

requires.hint: Port Guards watch the yard gate. Knock down 6 to pass.
Slingers on the container stacks cover the crane yard. Knock down 6 to pass.
Chen's crews still hold the road inland. Defeat the Harbourmaster first.
Plant Guards hold the factory doors. Knock down 6 to pass.

npcs.name: Dr. Pim
npcs.line: I measured the canal for six years. Nobody wanted the numbers.

requires.hint: Security Chief Nattapong guards the way to the waste pools.
Patrol Units seal the drains. Knock down 6 to pass.
Unit K-7 still guards the drains. Stop it to go on.
The runners watch the warehouse doors. Knock down 6 to pass.

npcs.name: Kenji
npcs.line: I sold information. I carried envelopes too. Let me make it right.

requires.hint: The Ringmaster bars the stairs up. Beat him to pass.
The enforcers guard the way to the tower. Knock down 6 to pass.
Big Sak still holds the tower. Beat him to go on.
Facility Troopers hold the gate. Knock down 6 to pass.

npcs.name: Dr. Pim
npcs.line: Six years of numbers, and here is where they lead.

requires.hint: Subject 12 blocks the way on. Stop him to pass.
The riot squad holds the hall. Knock down 6 Riot Troopers to pass.
Commander Arthit still holds the Control Room. Beat him to go on.
The last troopers hold the approach. Knock down 6 to pass.

npcs.name: Dr. Pim
npcs.line: Every number I ever took leads to this door.

requires.hint: The Hybrid Brutes keep the pumps running. Knock down 6 to pass.
The Core Sentinels guard the chamber door. Knock down 6 to pass.

npcs.name: Win
npcs.line: Story routes only: anywhere on the street you've been. Ten coins. For the outskirts, ask Uncle Thong.

npcs.name: Notice Board
npcs.line: Notices from all over the city, pinned three deep.

npcs.name: Ama
npcs.line: Everything the street sells, under one roof.

npcs.name: Workbench
npcs.line: Scrap, alloy and coins in, a better piece out. Pick worn gear to upgrade it.

npcs.name: Uncle Thong
npcs.line: My truck goes where the street doesn't: the farming grounds and whatever crawls out of the drains. Ten coins.

farm_saltmarket_backlots.name: Saltmarket Backlots
farm_saltmarket_backlots.purpose: Learn the farming loop against the Saltmarket crews; Scrap Metal for early upgrades.

farm_rail_sidings.name: Rail Sidings
farm_rail_sidings.purpose: The Baron's crews in the sidings behind the Refinery: coins for better gear, first Refined Alloy from the Enforcer.

farm_harbour_stacks.name: Harbour Stacks
farm_harbour_stacks.purpose: Container lanes held by the dock crews: heavy hitters in front, wrench throwers behind; Scrap Metal.

farm_plant_outskirts.name: Plant Outskirts
farm_plant_outskirts.purpose: The plant's fenced perimeter: slow armoured Patrol Units and Hazmat Sprayers; Scrap Metal and Refined Alloy.

farm_network_backrooms.name: Network Backrooms
farm_network_backrooms.purpose: Cash rooms behind the Counting House: fast runners, heavy collectors and a ring fighter; coins.

farm_facility_annex.name: Facility Annex
farm_facility_annex.purpose: The facility's storage wing: trooper squads, hazmat teams and patrol machines; Refined Alloy.

farm_core_overflow.name: Core Overflow
farm_core_overflow.purpose: The Core's overflow halls after the story, run by its backup machines and holdout troopers: endgame Scrap Metal, Refined Alloy and coins, and the bridge from the story into levels 50 and beyond.

farm_coolant_vaults.name: Coolant Vaults
farm_coolant_vaults.purpose: The Core's flooded coolant vaults below the Main Control Centre, held by the Director's loyal guard after the story: the first ground past level 50, Coolant gear and a rematch with Commander Arthit, reinstated.

farm_reactor_underworks.name: Reactor Underworks
farm_reactor_underworks.purpose: The reactor's underworks, where the Subject programme's last tank broke open: Underworks gear and a rematch with Subject Twelve, relapsed.

farm_foundry_depths.name: Foundry Depths
farm_foundry_depths.purpose: The old foundry under Iron City, still firing for whoever pays: Foundry gear and a rematch with Unit K-7, overdriven.

farm_iron_heart.name: The Iron Heart
farm_iron_heart.purpose: The machine heart the Director built under the city, the last ground before level 70: Heartforged gear, and the Wiroj Protocol (the Heart's defences, in his voice) waits in its core.

farm_core_spillway.name: Core Spillway
farm_core_spillway.purpose: The facility's spillway after the Control Room falls: the ground for levels 41-45 before the final chapter, with facility Refined Alloy and coins.

coolant_control_room.name: Coolant Control Room
coolant_control_room.purpose: Commander Arthit, Reinstated's stand at the end of the Coolant Vaults: a boss fight that comes back after every rest, with Reinstated gear.

underworks_tank_hall.name: Tank Hall
underworks_tank_hall.purpose: Subject Twelve, Relapsed's stand at the end of the Reactor Underworks: a boss fight that comes back after every rest, with Relapsed gear.

foundry_crucible.name: The Crucible
foundry_crucible.purpose: Unit K-7, Overdriven's stand at the end of the Foundry Depths: a boss fight that comes back after every rest, with Overdriven gear.

heart_core_chamber.name: Heart Core Chamber
heart_core_chamber.purpose: The Wiroj Protocol's stand at the end of the The Iron Heart: a boss fight that comes back after every rest, with Protocol gear.

spillway_gatehouse.name: Spillway Gatehouse
spillway_gatehouse.purpose: The spillway's gatehouse, where the Spillway Chief keeps the sluice keys: a boss fight that comes back after every rest, with Spillway Chief gear.
